Specify per-stage PCA compression

Source: R/hierarchy_recipe.R
block_pca.Rd

Specify per-stage PCA compression

Usage

block_pca(
  rank = NULL,
  method = c("stats", "eigencore"),
  feature_scale = c("sd", "center", "none"),
  score_weighting = c("singular", "whitened")
)

Arguments

rank

Integer scalar, named integer vector, or NULL. A scalar is recycled across stages. NULL keeps up to 50 components per stage (or fewer when a stage has fewer columns).

method

Character; "stats" uses stats::prcomp, "eigencore" uses eigencore::svd_partial when installed.

feature_scale

How to standardize raw columns before PCA: "sd" centers and scales, "center" centers only, "none" leaves columns unchanged.

score_weighting

"singular" keeps PCA scores as \(UD\); "whitened" scales each retained score to unit training SD.

Value

An object of class block_pca.
